title: PewDiePie just shipped his own open-source AI and got 30K GitHub stars in a day
description:
Comment ODYSSEUS and I'll DM you the link to the repo.

PewDiePie quietly shipped his own open-source AI and pulled 30,000+ GitHub stars in a single day.

It's called Odysseus, local ChatGPT alternative that runs on your machine. 270+ models supported, zero telemetry, Agent mode that runs tasks on its own. Three commands to install.

#AI #PewDiePie #Odysseus #opensource #fyp
